newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally higher in noon trading on Wednesday after deals in Medan and Palembang, traders said.

"Offer prices are generally higher after the overnight deals in Palembang and Medan. Rises in Tokyo in the last two days have also contributed to an uptrend in the local market," said one trader in Jakarta.
"But in general, prices may fall again anytime if buyers start to run away from rising offer prices," said another trader.
Traders said a deal was done at 43.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and 43.00 fob Palembang for September shipment.
Offer prices were quoted at 43.75 fob Medan, 43.25 fob Palembang and Surabaya and Surabaya and 43.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
